module: Minimal editor extension: registers an inspector handler for the "level_settings" selection type (which only displays the text "Level Settings") and adds editor.showLevelSettings() to select this pseudo-object.
usage: editor.showLevelSettings() -- opens the "Level Settings" panel in the inspector
notes: The panel only contains text: no setting is actually exposed by this file.
showLevelSettings replaces editor.selection with an empty table then sets editor.selection.level_settings = {1}.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads. Empty body.

onEditorActivated.desc: Called when the editor is activated: registers the "level_settings" inspector type and defines editor.showLevelSettings.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Called when the editor is deactivated: removes the "level_settings" inspector type.
